frozen_journeys.description: A signed-in free traveler upgrades to TripIt Pro (annual) by choosing a sandbox test outcome; an approved outcome activates the membership and enqueues a pro-receipt mail; declined leaves the traveler on the free tier; retryable converges to active on resubmit. No card, CVV, or bank detail is ever collected.

A Pro member cancels; the membership is marked cancel-at-period-end and every Pro benefit is retained until the current period end; the member may resume before the period ends. Cancellation never issues a refund charge and never touches trip or plan data.

payment_contract.amount_source: server-side TripIt Pro annual price snapshot (4900 USD minor units); the client never supplies or influences the amount
payment_contract.final_commit: consume_approval() and INSERT tripit_pro_subscriptions execute atomically in one transaction; a partial-unique active index makes a duplicate webhook or resubmit unable to activate twice
payment_contract.fingerprint: sha256('tripit|pro-annual|' + owner_key + '|' + billing_period) — canonical, idempotent across duplicate submits
payment_contract.owner: authenticated traveler; owner_key == traveler_key == account_id binds every flow, attempt, and subscription row

proof_obligations: Amounts are integer minor units computed server-side; the client only ever submits an opaque scenario id.
The Pro flow is idempotent on sha256('tripit|pro-annual|'+owner+'|'+period): duplicate submits activate at most one subscription and enqueue at most one pro-receipt.
consume_approval() precedes and shares a transaction with the tripit_pro_subscriptions write; a final-state mismatch cannot leave an active subscription.
A duplicate or replayed Stripe-test webhook cannot activate a second membership (ledger UNIQUE + one-active partial index).
The stripe-test optional adapter stays dormant until a named-human payment-scope approval wires runtime.json's stripe_test block; live Stripe keys are rejected and no credential fields are collected.
The Hilton anchor hotel-reservation journey touches no payment code path.
Cross-site account or payment reuse is rejected; sessions and webhook secrets are site-exclusive to tripit.
